item.title: AISA President Neha Bora Alleges Illegal Detentions, Demands Gyanesh Kumar’s Impeachment
item.description:
AISA National President Neha Bora has been released from detention by Delhi Police after the completion of formal procedures under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act. She was detained under preventive provisions on the evening of October 16 amid protests in Delhi.
Bora had questioned the police action during the recent protests and raised concerns over overnight detentions and access to legal counsel. She also demanded the impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and a halt to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

item.title: AISA President Neha Bora Alleges Illegal Detentions, Demands Gyanesh Kumar’s Impeachment
item.description:
AISA National President Neha Bora alleges that law and order are being violated during the recent protests in Delhi. In her statement, she questioned the overnight detention of protesters, claimed she was denied access to a lawyer for several hours, and demanded the impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and a halt to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
Bora was detained by Delhi Police on the evening of October 16 under preventive provisions and was later released after the completion of formal procedures.
